answer.question: What does TEAM International do for logistics and transportation companies?
answer.text: TEAM International is a logistics software development company that builds and runs the systems freight moves on: load management platforms, EDI and carrier integrations, fleet and delivery apps, and logistics automation. Arrive Logistics and a global tire manufacturer's fleet business rely on our teams in North American and European time zones, and we have supported Coyote Logistics.
answer.segmentsIntro: IT services for transportation and logistics companies, focused on mid-size operators that need enterprise-grade engineering.

items.q: What does a logistics software development company do?
items.a: A logistics software development company designs, builds, integrates and supports the software freight moves on: load and transportation management, EDI and carrier integrations, fleet and delivery apps, and automation. TEAM International does this for brokers, 3PLs, carriers and forwarders, from logistics and transportation software development to the support behind it.

items.q: What logistics software development services does TEAM International offer?
items.a: Four areas: load and freight management platforms; EDI and carrier integrations; fleet, field and delivery apps; and logistics automation, data and AI. These are our core logistics IT services and transportation IT solutions, and every engagement starts with a Logistics Discovery & Modernization Assessment.

items.q: Can you build on top of our TMS and EDI setup instead of replacing it?
items.a: Yes. Most work extends what already runs: new modules, EDI flows, carrier integrations and links to finance systems such as NetSuite. We replace only what blocks growth, and logistics software solutions keep running during the change.

items.q: Do you provide IT support for logistics operations?
items.a: Yes. We have run tier 1–3 support for Coyote Logistics, and IT support for logistics can be combined with development in one team.

items.q: What results has logistics automation delivered?
items.a: A 6-agent AI system we built for a freight forwarder reads 108-page PDFs in 10.8 minutes with zero missed items and cut operating costs by more than 63%. For Arrive Logistics, our EDI pipeline handles 100,000 loads with the same technical effort as 100.

items.q: How is AI used in logistics today?
items.a: The practical uses of AI in logistics are document extraction, routing and planning, and exception handling. The 2026 Third-Party Logistics Study reports that transportation planning and routing shows the strongest AI return for both shippers and 3PLs, and names data quality and legacy integration as the top barriers to scaling AI.

items.q: Do you work with mid-size logistics companies?
items.a: Yes. Mid-size brokers, 3PLs, carriers and forwarders are our focus; they get the same practices we use for enterprise fleet and freight clients.
With a Logistics Discovery & Modernization Assessment. From there you choose a dedicated team, project delivery or support, including supply chain software development for your internal platforms.
